name: Corrupted Overlord: Pompey
summary: • Boss enemies gain 1 stack of Battle-Hardened every 10s, increasing their DMG dealt by 20% and stacking up to 3 times. When inflicting Attribute Anomaly, removes 1 stack of Battle-Hardened and increases their DMG taken by 15% for 20s.
